column1: # Curated symbol table for the MStar MST9U "sboot" image.
# IMPORTANT: sboot is 8051 (Keil C51) code, NOT AEON. Addresses below are 8051
# CODE-space addresses for the sliced image sboot.bin[0x80:] (64 KB), i.e.
# Data rows live in 8051 XDATA/IRAM/SFR spaces and are documentation only
# (Ghidra's default space is CODE, so these labels may not auto-place).

column4: [C] Keil ?C_STARTUP: SP=0x76, zero IRAM, clear XDATA BSS 0x5000-0x5fff, copy init table @0x1ca8, then banked-call main
[C] Keil ?B_CALL banked far-call trampoline: push return bank+addr, LJMP bank-dispatch 0x2000
[C] printf-style format parser (%d/%x/width); emits chars via putchar(0x1c8e)
[I] indirect dispatch over 3-byte (key,funcptr) records; key matched against arg
[C] UART ISR (vector 0x23): RX byte -> ring buf xdata 0x5004 (widx xdata 0x5038, cap 0x32); TX-done sets iram bit 0x04
[C] SCON=0x50 (mode1,REN), PCON|=0x80 (SMOD), MStar baud SFR 0xBA=3 / 0xAA=0xD9, clear TI/RI, enable ES(0xAC)
[C] write SBUF (SFR 0x99); wait TX-done (iram bit 0x04 from ISR, else poll TI). Banked (bank0)
[C] write #0 to bank-select reg xdata 0x1019; mirror iram 0x13
[C] banked. init (0x8763,0x960a); print banner (arg xdata 0x503e); poll loop @0x8d90 -> 0x59c3 / poll 0x95e5 / 0x7c1b / 0x9568 / 0x9283
[C] XDATA/RIU: 8051 code-bank select (window 0x8000-0xffff); iram 0x13 mirrors it
[C] XDATA UART receive ring buffer (filled by isr_serial, 0x32 bytes)
[I] XDATA value printed in main's startup banner
[I] XDATA/RIU boot/clock ctrl written =0xff at startup
